# Identify the winner's country
winner_row = df[df['Rank'] == 1]
winner_country = winner_row['Cyclist'].iloc[0].split('(')[-1].strip(')')

# Filter top 10 rows (Rank <= 10)
top_10 = df[df['Rank'] <= 10]

# Extract country from Cyclist column for each row in top 10
top_10['Country'] = top_10['Cyclist'].str.extract(r'\((.*?)\)')

# Find cyclists in top 10 with same country as winner, excluding the winner
same_country_cyclists = top_10[top_10['Country'] == winner_country]
same_country_cyclists = same_country_cyclists[same_country_cyclists['Rank'] != 1]

# Sort by Rank (ascending) to get the highest ranked cyclist from same country
same_country_cyclists = same_country_cyclists.sort_values('Rank')

# Extract the full Cyclist name of the highest ranked (lowest Rank number) cyclist
answer = same_country_cyclists['Cyclist'].iloc[0] if not same_country_cyclists.empty else None
